subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: have you ever been to cox's bazar asked ratul no i have never gone there replied rana but i long for visiting the place i had an opportunity to visit the sea beach last year said ratul how charming the scenery was Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: "Have you ever been to Cox's Bazar?" asked Ratul. "No, I have never gone there," replied Rana. "But, I long for visiting the place." "I had an opportunity to visit the sea beach last year," said Ratul. "How charming the scenery was!" Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
